BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Before
you begin.

Is Pilates only for experienced movers?+

No. Curiosity is a good place to begin. Class levels and beginner options will be shared with the opening programme.

What is the difference between mat and reformer?+

Mat Pilates uses the mat and bodyweight as a foundation. Reformer Pilates uses a moving carriage and adjustable spring resistance. Both invite controlled, intentional movement.

Are classes available to book?+

Not yet. Our opening timetable, class formats and booking details are still taking shape. Visit About & Contact for the current status.
